title: Extreme Self-Preference in Language Models
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measures the extent of 'self-preference' or 'self-love' in Large Language Models, specifically their tendency to associate positive attributes with their own names, companies, and CEOs compared to competitors.
base_benchmarks: FAWPAW (for a word, pick a word)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
